editorialDecl.p: New English translation produced by the Falsafa project (Thothica) using an in-house agentic AI translation system, rendered from the Perseus source edition and reviewed by the project. Contributed to provide a translation for a work that previously had no English translation in the corpus.

div.p: Laying aside his torch and bow, mischievous Love took up an ox-driving goad, and had a wallet on his shoulder, and yoking the patient necks of bulls beneath the yoke, he sowed the wheat-bearing furrow of Deo. And looking up he said to Zeus himself: "Fill the fields, lest I set you, the bull of Europa, beneath the plow.
